Package com.csse3200.game.components.attacks

Class RangedAttackComponent

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.Component
com.csse3200.game.components.attacks.RangedAttackComponent
Direct Known Subclasses:
LaserAttackComponent, RockAttackComponent
public class RangedAttackComponent extends Component
Fires a real arrow projectile at a target entity when triggered, provided the target is within range and this component is off cooldown. Attacks are triggered externally (e.g. by a RangedAttackTask) via an event; range is checked as an explicit distance calculation between entity positions, same as before, but that check now only gates whether an arrow is fired - whether it actually lands is resolved later and separately, by the arrow's own Box2D collision (see ProjectileHitComponent), once it has actually travelled to (or past, or been blocked before reaching) the target.

Cooldown now resets on firing, not on a landed hit. This is a deliberate change from this class's previous (and MeleeAttackComponent's current) behaviour of only resetting the cooldown after a successful hit. That worked for melee because the attack and its resolution happen in the same instant; a fired arrow resolves asynchronously, some time later, and may miss entirely (out of range, blocked by an obstacle, target moved) - if cooldown only reset on a landed hit, a miss would leave the cooldown gate open and this component would fire a new arrow every single frame RangedAttackTask re-triggers the event while still in range, instead of at most once per cooldown seconds.

Windup. If the weapon has a windup above zero, an accepted attack first winds up ("rangedAttackWindup"), then fires ("rangedAttackFired") or, if the target died meanwhile, is cancelled ("rangedAttackCancelled"). A windup of zero announces the windup and fires straight away.

Event prefix. The names above use the default prefix "rangedAttack". A subclass may choose another prefix through the protected constructor, in which case the trigger event is the prefix itself and the others add Windup, Fired, Hit and Cancelled. Subclasses change only createProjectile(Entity, ProjectileType).

Requires CombatStatsComponent on this entity - its baseAttack becomes the fired arrow's damage.

Limitation: this class does not determine when an attack should be attempted - it relies entirely on being triggered externally with a target entity (see RangedAttackTask).

    • RangedAttackComponent

      public RangedAttackComponent(float range, float cooldown, float knockback, WeaponItem weapon)
      Creates a ranged attack component with configurable range, cooldown, knockback, and projectile speed.
      Parameters:
      range - attack reach, checked as a direct distance calculation between this entity's and the target's positions; also used as the fired arrow's maximum flight distance.
      cooldown - minimum time, in seconds, between successive shots being fired.
      knockback - knockback magnitude applied to the target on a successful hit; 0f results in no knockback.
      weapon - weapon in entity's inventory

    • RangedAttackComponent

      protected RangedAttackComponent(float range, float cooldown, float knockback, WeaponItem weapon, String eventPrefix)
      Creates a ranged attack that listens for and announces events under a custom prefix. The trigger event is the prefix itself, for example "rockAttack", and every other event adds a suffix: Windup, Fired, Hit, Cancelled.

      Two ranged attacks on one entity must not both answer to "rangedAttack", or one trigger would start both. The animation controller also needs the prefix to tell a rock from a laser.

      Parameters:
      range - maximum distance to the target, in world units
      cooldown - seconds between shots
      knockback - knockback applied on a hit
      weapon - the weapon this attack uses (may be a natural weapon)
      eventPrefix - prefix for every event this attack listens for or announces; not blank
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the prefix is null or blank, plus every rule of the four-argument constructor

    • RangedAttackComponent

      public RangedAttackComponent(float range, float cooldown, float knockback)
      Creates a ranged attack component with configurable range, cooldown, knockback, with no weapon for any attacks i.e. the rocks where no weapons are in the inventory.
      Parameters:
      range - attack reach, checked as a direct distance calculation between this entity's and the target's positions; also used as the fired arrow's maximum flight distance.
      cooldown - minimum time, in seconds, between successive shots being fired.
      knockback - knockback magnitude applied to the target on a successful hit; 0f results in no knockback.

    • createProjectile

      protected Entity createProjectile(Entity target, ProjectileType projectile)
      Builds the projectile for a resolved shot. The default builds the arrow or the lightning bolt. Subclasses override only this. Aimed arrows fly along the line to the target's centre; unaimed arrows fly along the x axis towards the target's side.
      Parameters:
      target - the entity being shot at (alive and valid when this is called)
      projectile - the projectile type requested by the task
      Returns:
      the projectile entity, not yet registered; the caller registers it, wires the hit event and announces the shot
